title: Existence of bound entanglement with negative partial transpose
statement: Does there exist a finite-dimensional bipartite density operator rho with rho^{T_B} not positive semidefinite, but with zero distillable entanglement under local operations and classical communication? Equivalently, find one NPT state whose every tensor power is nonnegative on all Schmidt-rank-two test vectors after partial transpose, or prove no such state exists.
assumptions: Finite local Hilbert-space dimensions; arbitrary numbers of identical copies.
Unassisted LOCC, not the larger class of PPT-preserving operations.
physics_motivation: Determines whether physically entangled states can have a nonpositive partial transpose yet yield no usable singlets even asymptotically.
resolution_target: A single explicitly defined NPT state with an all-copy undistillability proof, or a proof that every NPT state is distillable.
status_note: Finite-copy evidence does not establish all-copy undistillability. The IQOQI problem page and the cited review formulate the unresolved question; their status is not a complete 2026 literature audit.

sources.title: IQOQI Open Quantum Problems, Problem 2: Undistillability implies PPT?
Five open problems in quantum information

title: Existence of SIC-POVMs in every finite Hilbert-space dimension
statement: For every integer d>=2, prove that there are d^2 normalized vectors psi_i in C^d satisfying |<psi_i,psi_j>|^2=1/(d+1) for i!=j. Their rank-one projectors divided by d form a symmetric informationally complete POVM.
assumptions: All finite dimensions, not only prime-power or individually solved dimensions.
Weyl-Heisenberg covariance and Zauner symmetry are optional stronger structures, not assumptions of this existence question.
physics_motivation: Asks whether a maximally symmetric minimal informationally complete quantum measurement exists for every qudit.
resolution_target: A general exact existence theorem or a dimension with a proof of impossibility.
status_note: Many exact constructions and extensive numerical evidence do not settle every dimension. The stronger symmetry conjectures are not duplicated as separate records here.

sources.title: Five open problems in quantum information
IQOQI: SIC POVMs and Zauner's Conjecture

relations.note: Distinct operational measurement-design problem.

title: Exact quantum capacity of the qubit depolarizing channel
statement: Determine the unassisted quantum capacity Q(D_p) of D_p(rho)=(1-p)rho+p I/2 for 0<=p<=1, including the noise threshold below which quantum communication has positive asymptotic rate. Establish matching achievable rates and converse bounds across the unresolved parameter range.
assumptions: Independent memoryless uses of this channel, with arbitrary block encoders and decoders.
No preshared entanglement, feedback or classical side channel; p is the replacement-by-maximally-mixed convention.
physics_motivation: Gives the fundamental achievable rate of quantum information transmission under isotropic qubit noise.
resolution_target: A capacity formula with coding and converse proofs, or an equivalent rigorous characterization that closes the current upper/lower-bound gap.
status_note: The regularized coherent-information formula is known but is not an evaluated answer. Channel parameter conventions and assisted capacities must not be confused.

sources.title: From Classical to Quantum Shannon Theory
PubPhys: Quantum Shannon theory

title: Quantum PCP conjecture for local Hamiltonians
statement: Prove or disprove that approximating the ground-state energy density of bounded-norm k-local Hamiltonians to some constant additive accuracy is QMA-hard, for a fixed k and a fixed finite local dimension, with the reduction model stated explicitly.
assumptions: H=sum_i h_i with 0<=h_i<=I and a promise gap proportional to the number of local terms.
No imposed Euclidean-lattice geometry. Use the quantum-polynomial-time reduction formulation of the cited survey unless strengthening it is justified.
physics_motivation: Asks whether low-energy physics remains computationally hard even at constant energy-density resolution.
resolution_target: A constant-relative-gap hardness theorem or a disproof of the precisely chosen conjecture.
status_note: The NLTS theorem is not the quantum PCP theorem. A 2025 quantum-PCP paper discusses further formulations and barriers without resolving the full question.

sources.title: The Quantum PCP Conjecture
Quantum PCPs: on Adaptivity, Multiple Provers and Reductions to Local Hamiltonians

relations.note: Both constrain complexity of low-energy entanglement, but geometric locality and the assertions differ.

title: Fully self-correcting quantum memory in three spatial dimensions
statement: Construct a three-dimensional family of finite-range, uniformly bounded local Hamiltonians with fixed on-site dimension encoding at least one qubit, whose passive memory lifetime grows at least exponentially in a positive power of linear size at a fixed nonzero temperature under a specified class of generic local thermal noise, or establish a no-go theorem for that class.
assumptions: Protect both logical observables, not only a classical bit.
Local detailed-balance noise with size-independent local rates; decoding may occur at readout, but no active correction during storage.
State robustness requirements and the order of temperature and size limits explicitly.
physics_motivation: Would establish whether stable quantum information can be stored as a genuine three-dimensional thermal phase.
resolution_target: A Hamiltonian construction plus rigorous lifetime and robustness bounds, or an impossibility theorem under the same assumptions.
status_note: Four-dimensional constructions, energy barriers alone, and memories whose apparent lifetime stops growing at fixed temperature do not meet this target.

sources.title: Quantum memories at finite temperature
PubPhys: Self-correcting quantum memories at finite temperature

title: Four-dimensional quantum Yang-Mills existence and mass gap
statement: For every compact simple gauge group G, construct a nontrivial quantum Yang-Mills theory on four-dimensional spacetime satisfying the axiomatic requirements in the Jaffe-Witten problem statement and prove a strictly positive mass gap above its vacuum.
assumptions: Pure gauge theory, without matter or an imposed infrared cutoff.
An infinite-volume continuum theory, not only a fixed-spacing lattice model or perturbative series.
physics_motivation: Provides rigorous foundations for dynamical mass generation in non-Abelian gauge theory, including the pure-gluon sector related to QCD.
resolution_target: A construction meeting the official axioms and a positive continuum spectral-gap bound.
status_note: The Clay page labels the problem unsolved. Continuum existence, finite-cutoff bounds and a mass gap are different obligations; a claim covering only one is insufficient.

sources.title: Clay Mathematics Institute: Yang-Mills and the Mass Gap
Yang-Mills for probabilists

relations.note: Wilson-loop confinement is a distinct observable statement, not identical to a mass-gap proof.

title: Wilson-loop area law for four-dimensional SU(3) gauge theory at weak coupling
statement: For pure SU(3) Wilson lattice gauge theory on Z^4, prove a positive asymptotic string tension for sufficiently weak nonzero bare coupling, using large rectangular fundamental Wilson loops or the associated static-source potential. Specify infinite-volume and large-loop limits; distinguish the fixed-spacing result from a continuum-limit theorem.
assumptions: Zero temperature; no dynamical fundamental quarks, which would cause string breaking.
Weak coupling, rather than the established strong-coupling expansion regime.
physics_motivation: Establishes the linear energy cost of separating unscreened color sources in a QCD-related microscopic gauge model.
resolution_target: A rigorously positive large-distance string tension in the stated weak-coupling regime.
status_note: An area law at strong lattice coupling and numerical evidence at weak coupling do not settle this statement. Continuum scaling remains an additional task.

sources.title: The confinement problem in lattice gauge theory
Yang-Mills for probabilists

relations.note: Shared gauge-theory setting; no equivalence between the two conjectures is assumed.
Chiral order requires dynamical fermions and a different order parameter.

title: Six-dimensional a-theorem for general unitary RG flows
statement: For unitary, local, Lorentz-invariant six-dimensional quantum field theories flowing between conformal ultraviolet and infrared fixed points, prove that the Euler-density Weyl-anomaly coefficient obeys a_UV>=a_IR in a common normalization, with strict decrease for an appropriate nontrivial flow, or construct a counterexample.
assumptions: Well-defined fixed-point stress tensors and anomaly coefficients.
No restriction to supersymmetric tensor-branch flows or holographic theories.
physics_motivation: Would establish irreversible loss of degrees of freedom under coarse graining in six dimensions.
resolution_target: A nonperturbative argument for general flows, or a consistent flow violating the claimed inequality.
status_note: Lower-dimensional theorems and special six-dimensional supersymmetric results do not establish the unrestricted six-dimensional assertion.

PubPhys: Irreversibility of renormalization group flows

relations.note: Six-dimensional conformal theories provide test cases, not a general proof.

title: All-loop color-kinematics duality for Yang-Mills amplitudes
statement: Establish whether every perturbative pure Yang-Mills scattering amplitude admits a cubic-graph loop-integrand representation whose kinematic numerators satisfy the same antisymmetry and Jacobi identities as the color factors, at arbitrary loop order and multiplicity.
assumptions: State regularization, generalized-gauge freedom, loop-momentum routing and allowed numerator singularities.
Do not impose extra locality or power-counting conditions that can obstruct particular ansatzes without refuting the broader duality.
physics_motivation: Would justify replacing color factors by kinematic numerators to construct gravity amplitudes beyond known cases.
resolution_target: An all-loop construction reproducing generalized unitarity cuts, or an obstruction to a precisely specified admissible representation class.
status_note: Tree-level proofs and many explicit multiloop examples do not constitute an all-loop theorem. Restricted-ansatz failures must be distinguished from failure of the duality.

sources.title: The SAGEX Review, Chapter 2: An Invitation to Color-Kinematics Duality and the Double Copy

title: Nonperturbative lattice construction of anomaly-free non-Abelian chiral gauge theories
statement: Construct a local, gauge-invariant nonperturbative lattice fermion measure for general four-dimensional anomaly-free non-Abelian chiral representations, with controlled global integrability across the chosen admissible gauge-field sectors and the intended continuum chiral spectrum without unwanted mirror fermions.
assumptions: Cancel both perturbative and global anomalies of the specified gauge group and representation.
A lattice formulation alone and a fully interacting continuum existence theorem are separate milestones.
physics_motivation: Would give chiral interactions, including Standard-Model-like gauge sectors, a controlled definition beyond perturbation theory.
resolution_target: An explicit measure and action with proofs of locality, gauge invariance, global consistency and the claimed fermion content.
status_note: Abelian constructions, perturbative non-Abelian constructions and particular mirror-decoupling proposals do not automatically solve the general problem. Modern regulator proposals need further full-text review.

sources.title: Chiral gauge theories revisited
PubPhys: Lattice definition of chiral gauge theories

title: Triviality or an interacting continuum limit of four-dimensional QED
statement: For four-dimensional QED with a photon and a fixed finite set of massive charged Dirac fields, determine whether removal of an ultraviolet regulator can yield a local unitary continuum theory with a nonzero renormalized charge at a fixed physical scale, or whether every admissible continuum limit has zero charge.
assumptions: Specify the regulator, observable algebra, positivity requirements and renormalization conditions.
No additional ultraviolet degrees of freedom; an effective theory with independent higher-dimension couplings is a different target.
physics_motivation: Asks whether QED can exist as an interacting theory at arbitrarily short distances or necessarily requires an ultraviolet completion.
resolution_target: A nonperturbative interacting construction or a regulator-class triviality theorem with explicit scope.
status_note: A perturbative Landau pole is not a nonperturbative proof of triviality. The cited effective-theory discussion illustrates why changes of ultraviolet assumptions must not be mistaken for a solution of the pure-QED target.

sources.title: Triviality of quantum electrodynamics revisited
Snowmass Theory Frontier Report

relations.note: Ultraviolet existence and infrared charged-particle scattering are distinct limits.

title: Infrared-complete scattering theory for charged particles in QED
statement: Construct physical charged asymptotic states with their soft-photon clouds and prove an infrared-finite scattering theory with an appropriate completeness statement. A sharply controlled first target is fixed-ultraviolet-cutoff nonrelativistic QED with interacting charged particles and photons, before attempting full relativistic QED.
assumptions: Long-range Coulomb interaction and arbitrarily soft photons are retained.
Specify charge sectors, infrared representation, dressing and modified wave operators; ordinary charged Fock scattering is not assumed.
Relativistic and cutoff nonrelativistic results must be labelled separately.
physics_motivation: Explains how electron scattering arises from quantum dynamics when a charged particle cannot be separated from its electromagnetic radiation cloud.
resolution_target: Existence and completeness of the specified modified wave operators and a derivation of physical scattering probabilities without an infrared cutoff.
status_note: Inclusive cross sections, perturbative dressed S-matrices and solvable no-recoil models give important partial answers, not general nonperturbative completeness.

sources.title: Infrared problem in quantum electrodynamics

relations.note: A fixed ultraviolet cutoff isolates this infrared problem from continuum existence.

title: Spontaneous chiral symmetry breaking from four-dimensional QCD
aliases: Microscopic derivation of the QCD chiral condensate
statement: In SU(3) gauge theory with two degenerate fundamental quark flavors at zero temperature, theta=0 and zero chemical potential, derive a nonzero chiral condensate in the infinite-volume limit followed by the quark-mass-to-zero limit, establishing SU(2)_L x SU(2)_R breaking to SU(2)_V and the associated Goldstone sector.
assumptions: A controlled continuum QCD definition is supplied or explicitly assumed.
Take volume to infinity before removing the symmetry-breaking mass; use renormalized order parameters.
Do not assume a low-energy effective potential already exhibiting the desired broken symmetry.
physics_motivation: Derives the dynamical origin of the light-pion sector and chiral order from quark and gluon dynamics.
resolution_target: A nonzero condensate or equivalent chiral order parameter with the correct limit order and a controlled symmetry-breaking argument.
status_note: Lattice evidence, anomaly constraints and chiral effective theory do not by themselves prove spontaneous breaking in continuum QCD.

sources.title: Snowmass Theory Frontier Report
PubPhys: Confinement in QCD-like gauge theories

relations.note: Confinement and chiral symmetry breaking have different order parameters and hypotheses.
Changing the number of massless flavors may change the infrared phase.

title: Determine the conformal window of massless SU(3) gauge theory
aliases: Lower edge of the QCD-like conformal window
statement: Determine for which integer flavor numbers 2<=N_f<=16 the four-dimensional SU(3) gauge theory with N_f massless fundamental Dirac fermions has a nontrivial infrared conformal fixed point, and characterize the transition to chiral symmetry breaking at the lower edge.
assumptions: Zero temperature and density; no supersymmetry or extra interactions.
The continuum and massless limits must be distinguished from finite-volume walking behavior.
physics_motivation: Determines when a QCD-like microscopic theory produces conformal matter instead of a chirally broken phase.
resolution_target: Controlled analytic proofs of the infrared phase for the unresolved N_f values, with a defined criterion for conformality.
status_note: Perturbative Banks-Zaks fixed points and finite-volume lattice estimates do not settle the strongly coupled lower edge. This is a phase-classification problem, not the two-flavor condensate question repeated.

sources.title: Lattice Study of the Conformal Window in QCD-like Theories

relations.note: The two-flavor theory is one member, but this target is the conformal-window boundary.

title: Infrared phase of pure SU(2) Yang-Mills at theta equal to pi
statement: Determine how the mixed time-reversal/center anomaly of four-dimensional pure SU(2) Yang-Mills at theta=pi is matched in the zero-temperature infrared theory: in particular, establish spontaneous CP breaking with degenerate vacua, or a consistent alternative such as gaplessness or nontrivial topological order.
assumptions: Pure SU(2), infinite volume, theta exactly pi; specify the continuum definition.
Do not assume confinement and a trivially gapped infrared sector as part of the desired conclusion.
physics_motivation: Tests what anomaly constraints actually imply for vacuum structure in strongly coupled gauge theory.
resolution_target: A controlled derivation of the realized infrared phase and its anomaly matching, not only a list of allowed possibilities.
status_note: The anomaly rules out a trivial nondegenerate gapped vacuum but does not uniquely select CP breaking; the cited paper explicitly discusses alternatives.

sources.title: Theta, Time Reversal, and Temperature
PubPhys: Vacuum structure of SU(2) at theta=pi

relations.note: Special theta-angle vacuum question, not the theta=0 existence/mass-gap target.

title: d-wave superconducting order in the repulsive square-lattice Hubbard model
statement: Determine whether the nearest-neighbor repulsive Hubbard model on the square lattice has a zero-temperature phase with d_(x^2-y^2) pair off-diagonal long-range order on a nonempty open range of U/t>0 and hole density 0<delta<1. Prove the existence of such a phase or rule out the proposed order in the precisely stated model.
assumptions: H=-t sum_<i,j>,s (c^dagger_(i,s)c_(j,s)+h.c.)+U sum_i n_(i,up)n_(i,down); fixed-density thermodynamic limit.
Nearest-neighbor hopping only; no attractive interaction or pre-imposed pairing mean field.
Zero temperature avoids conflating true order with a finite-temperature BKT question.
physics_motivation: Tests whether a minimal repulsive electronic Hamiltonian generates unconventional superconductivity by itself.
resolution_target: A controlled nonzero long-distance d-wave pair correlation, with uniform thermodynamic estimates over a stated parameter region, or a no-go result.
status_note: Numerical phase diagrams and uncontrolled extrapolations are not proofs. The review emphasizes disputed ground-state regimes; stripes and competing orders must be considered.

sources.title: The Hubbard Model

relations.note: Both concern microscopic emergence of order, but are different physical theories and order parameters.

title: Construct the non-Gaussian conformal scaling limit of the critical 3D Ising model
statement: For the nearest-neighbor ferromagnetic Ising model on Z^3 at its critical temperature, construct a nontrivial scaling limit of the appropriately normalized magnetization field and prove its non-Gaussian character and conformal covariance, with explicitly defined observables and convergence topology.
assumptions: Zero external field; lattice spacing tends to zero with the critical parameter fixed.
Separate existence, uniqueness, conformal covariance and universality across other lattice models; the last is not presumed.
physics_motivation: Connects a microscopic three-dimensional magnet to the interacting conformal theory used to predict its critical exponents.
resolution_target: A rigorous construction and conformal-covariance theorem for the scaling limit, rather than an agreement of measured exponents.
status_note: Two-dimensional exact results, high-dimensional Gaussian limits and numerical bootstrap islands do not settle this microscopic three-dimensional construction.

sources.title: 100 Years of the (Critical) Ising Model on the Hypercubic Lattice
Snowmass White Paper: The Numerical Conformal Bootstrap

relations.note: Related symmetry issue in a different dimension and with different starting assumptions.

title: Kerr uniqueness without an analyticity assumption
aliases: Smooth black-hole rigidity and uniqueness problem
statement: Prove that an appropriately regular, smooth, four-dimensional, stationary, asymptotically flat vacuum black-hole spacetime with connected nondegenerate horizon and a globally regular domain of outer communications is Kerr, without assuming analyticity or axisymmetry at the outset.
assumptions: State global causality, completeness and horizon hypotheses explicitly.
Nondegenerate connected horizon; neither extremal nor multiple-black-hole configurations are silently included.
physics_motivation: Tests the no-hair characterization of equilibrium vacuum black holes under physically natural smoothness assumptions.
resolution_target: Smooth stationary rigidity supplying the missing symmetry, followed by a uniqueness theorem, or a non-Kerr counterexample satisfying all hypotheses.
status_note: Analytic and axisymmetric uniqueness theorems and perturbative smooth results do not establish the unrestricted smooth case.

sources.title: Mathematical General Relativity
PubPhys: Is Kerr the only smooth stationary vacuum black hole?

relations.note: Stationary classification versus dynamical return to equilibrium.

title: Weak cosmic censorship for generic asymptotically flat vacuum data
statement: Formulate and prove that generic smooth asymptotically flat initial data for the 3+1-dimensional vacuum Einstein equations have a maximal development with complete future null infinity, so singular behavior produced in gravitational collapse is not visible to distant observers.
assumptions: Specify the weighted initial-data topology and the meaning of generic, such as an open dense set in a chosen class.
Distinguish vacuum data from matter models that can develop unrelated singularities.
Exclude neither collapse nor black-hole formation by assuming small data.
physics_motivation: Asks whether classical gravitational collapse preserves predictability for observers outside black holes.
resolution_target: A generic-data global theorem with a precise asymptotic-completeness statement, or stable naked-singularity counterexamples in the same class.
status_note: Special-symmetry theorems and nongeneric naked-singularity examples do not settle this general vacuum formulation.

sources.title: Mathematical General Relativity

relations.note: Weak censorship concerns visibility from infinity; strong censorship concerns extendibility and determinism.

title: Electric weak gravity conjecture for four-dimensional U(1) quantum gravity
statement: In a consistent asymptotically flat four-dimensional quantum-gravity theory with an unbroken compact U(1), establish whether there must be a state whose charge-to-mass ratio is at least that of an extremal large Reissner-Nordstrom black hole, using a common normalization and accounting for additional massless fields.
assumptions: State the admissible ultraviolet-complete theory class and the extremality convention.
This is the electric existence version; magnetic, sublattice, tower and multi-charge convex-hull versions are stronger or different statements.
physics_motivation: Would constrain charged spectra through black-hole discharge and connect infrared gauge interactions to quantum-gravity consistency.
resolution_target: A derivation for a precisely specified class of quantum-gravity theories or a controlled ultraviolet-complete counterexample.
status_note: Large classes of string examples and consistency arguments support versions of the conjecture, but version-dependent claims must not be conflated into a universal theorem.

title: Infinite-distance light-tower conjecture in string compactifications
statement: For controlled continuous moduli families of string compactifications, determine whether every infinite geodesic-distance limit in the physical scalar-field metric is accompanied by an infinite tower whose characteristic mass decreases exponentially with distance in Planck units, m_tower~exp(-alpha d) with alpha>0.
assumptions: Use the physical, appropriately quantum-corrected metric and specify the asymptotic path.
The effective-theory cutoff may decrease along the path.
No universal sharp lower bound on alpha or emergent-string dichotomy is included in this basic version.
physics_motivation: Would delimit how far scalar fields can move while a fixed finite-field effective description remains valid.
resolution_target: An asymptotic theorem for a broad, precisely defined class of compactifications or a controlled counterexample.
status_note: Many supersymmetric and geometric limits are understood. Such cases do not establish every quantum-corrected compactification limit; this record keeps stronger variants as aliases/topics rather than duplicate problems.

sources.title: The Swampland: Introduction and Review

title: Absence of exact global symmetries in quantum gravity beyond AdS
statement: Establish a no-global-symmetry theorem for a precisely defined class of asymptotically flat quantum-gravity theories, or produce a consistent counterexample with an exact internal global symmetry acting nontrivially on physical states.
assumptions: Distinguish internal global symmetries from gauge redundancies, asymptotic symmetries and approximate effective symmetries.
State the axioms for physical observables, locality and black-hole states.
Do not assume an AdS boundary CFT in the desired non-AdS theorem.
physics_motivation: Constrains whether exact global conservation laws can survive black-hole formation and evaporation.
resolution_target: A theorem or ultraviolet-complete counterexample under explicit non-AdS assumptions.
status_note: AdS/CFT-based results and black-hole heuristics are important but do not automatically prove a framework-independent asymptotically flat statement.

title: A nonperturbative finite-N formulation and proof of AdS5/CFT4
aliases: Maldacena conjecture for N=4 SYM and type IIB strings
statement: Give independently meaningful nonperturbative definitions of four-dimensional N=4 SU(N) super-Yang-Mills and type IIB string theory with AdS5 x S5 boundary conditions and N units of five-form flux, and establish their equivalence through a dictionary of states and observables at finite N and finite coupling.
assumptions: Separate the decoupled U(1) sector from SU(N) where appropriate.
Protected observables, planar integrability and classical-supergravity limits are restricted tests, not the full assertion.
A bulk definition solely declared to be the boundary theory does not independently prove the correspondence.
physics_motivation: Would turn the most developed holographic duality into a controlled equivalence of quantum theories, including finite-N gravity effects.
resolution_target: A mathematically specified dictionary preserving dynamics and a sufficiently complete set of correlation functions or observables.
status_note: There is extensive evidence and exact sector-by-sector progress. The proposed full finite-N proof is a foundational program with definition-level prerequisites.

title: Emergence of eleven-dimensional Lorentz invariance in BFSS matrix theory
statement: For the supersymmetric U(N) matrix quantum mechanics proposed by BFSS, construct a controlled large-N scattering limit appropriate to uncompactified M-theory and show that physical amplitudes or the limiting symmetry generators obey eleven-dimensional Lorentz invariance, including the nonmanifest boosts.
assumptions: Specify longitudinal momentum scaling, center-of-mass separation, asymptotic states and the large-N limit.
Do not extrapolate a fixed finite-N or low-order velocity expansion into a proof for the full scattering theory.
physics_motivation: Tests whether a quantum-mechanical matrix model reproduces a relativistic eleven-dimensional gravitational theory.
resolution_target: Existence of the limiting observables and Lorentz Ward identities or a closed Lorentz algebra on a controlled physical domain.
status_note: Supersymmetric checks and long-distance supergravity matching are partial evidence; the general large-N Lorentz-invariant limit remains the target.

title: Existence or obstruction of parametrically controlled metastable de Sitter string vacua
statement: Determine whether a specified class of string compactifications admits metastable four-dimensional de Sitter vacua with all moduli stabilized and parametrically controlled corrections, including a demonstrated hierarchy separating the Hubble scale from Kaluza-Klein and string scales, or prove an obstruction within that same class.
assumptions: State the string theory, compactification data, sources and admissible corrections.
Quantify string-loop, alpha-prime and backreaction errors; distinguish parametric control from a numerical estimate at a single vacuum.
A no-go theorem for one restricted class does not exclude every de Sitter realization.
physics_motivation: Tests whether a positive-cosmological-constant effective universe can arise in controlled string theory.
resolution_target: A controlled metastable construction with bounded errors, or a no-go theorem with explicit hypotheses.
status_note: This is actively contested. Proposed vacua and restrictive no-go theorems do not settle the full controlled-existence question; the seed does not endorse either side.

title: Rigorous microscopic derivation of generalized hydrodynamics for the Lieb-Liniger gas
statement: For the repulsive Lieb-Liniger gas prepared in a smoothly inhomogeneous local generalized Gibbs state, prove convergence of coarse-grained conserved densities and currents under Euler space-time scaling to the generalized hydrodynamic evolution of the rapidity distribution.
assumptions: One-dimensional continuum bosons with fixed positive delta-interaction strength.
Specify the class of local ensembles, observables, convergence and time interval, initially before singularities of the macroscopic solution.
Derive the limit from unitary microscopic dynamics rather than assume local equilibration or the kinetic closure.
physics_motivation: Provides a rigorous bridge from an exactly interacting quantum gas to experimentally relevant ballistic transport profiles.
resolution_target: A scaling-limit theorem with controlled errors and the Bethe-dressed effective velocity in the limiting equation.
status_note: Exact thermodynamics, current formulas and successful GHD predictions are different from a general microscopic inhomogeneous hydrodynamic-limit proof.

Different dimension, regime and observable.

title: Rigorous Euler hydrodynamic limit of the classical Toda chain
statement: For the classical Toda chain H=sum_j[p_j^2/2+exp(-(q_(j+1)-q_j))] with slowly varying local generalized Gibbs initial data, prove that empirical conserved fields converge under Euler scaling to the Toda generalized hydrodynamic equations with the correct state-dependent effective velocities.
assumptions: Specify normalizable local ensembles, stretch/pressure conditions and thermodynamic limit.
Control deterministic dynamics and fluctuations without adding stochastic noise that changes the model.
physics_motivation: Explains macroscopic transport in a nonlinear integrable mechanical chain directly from Hamilton's equations.
resolution_target: A law-of-large-numbers hydrodynamic-limit theorem for an explicit nontrivial class of inhomogeneous states.
status_note: The thermodynamic Bethe ansatz, averaged-current identities and solutions of proposed Euler equations do not by themselves prove microscopic convergence. Recent Toda thermodynamics papers should be checked for the exact remaining scope.

title: Microscopic kinetic limit of a spatially inhomogeneous dense KdV soliton gas
statement: For an explicitly constructed random dense ensemble of KdV multi-soliton or finite-gap solutions with slowly varying spectral statistics, prove convergence of coarse-grained spectral density to the soliton-gas kinetic equation, including its collision-induced effective-velocity closure.
assumptions: Specify ensemble, thermodynamic scaling, admissible spectral densities and a macroscopic time interval.
KdV evolution is deterministic; distinguish a rigorous limit from a collision-rate ansatz or formally interchanged Whitham limits.
physics_motivation: Derives a statistical transport law for dense nonlinear wave fields relevant to soliton gases and integrable turbulence.
resolution_target: A theorem connecting a stated microscopic random-wave ensemble to the kinetic equation with quantified convergence.
status_note: Finite-gap thermodynamic constructions and solved kinetic reductions are important progress. The unresolved target here is a controlled, spatially inhomogeneous microscopic dynamical limit; exact admissible ensemble classes need full-text review.

title: KPZ scaling of spin correlations in the isotropic spin-1/2 Heisenberg chain
statement: For the infinite isotropic spin-1/2 Heisenberg chain at infinite temperature and zero mean magnetization, prove the predicted long-time scaling C(x,t)=<S_x^z(t)S_0^z(0)> asymptotically proportional to t^(-2/3) f_KPZ(x/(lambda t)^(2/3)), with the normalization and coefficient lambda fixed from the microscopic model.
assumptions: Take the infinite-chain limit before the long-time limit; no integrability-breaking perturbation or magnetic bias.
Specify the correlation scaling sense and distinguish the exponent from convergence to the full scaling function.
physics_motivation: Explains anomalous spin transport in a quantum magnet through an unexpected link with a classical stochastic universality class.
resolution_target: A microscopic theorem for the dynamic exponent and scaling function, or a demonstration of a different asymptotic law.
status_note: Kinetic theory, simulations and experiments give strong support. They do not substitute for the unrestricted long-time quantum-correlation theorem stated here.

title: Intrinsic construction of the interacting six-dimensional (2,0) theory
statement: Give an intrinsic nonperturbative definition of the interacting A_(N-1) six-dimensional (2,0) theory for N>=2, with a controlled physical Hilbert space or operator/correlation-function framework, locality and unitarity, and derive its protected anomalies and compactification relations without using them only as defining guesses.
assumptions: Distinguish the interacting relative theory from its free center-of-mass tensor multiplet.
State how self-dual tensor degrees of freedom and extended observables are represented.
A conventional Lagrangian is not required; an intrinsic mathematically controlled quantum theory is.
physics_motivation: Defines the worldvolume theory of coincident M5-branes and a central source of lower-dimensional supersymmetric dualities.
resolution_target: A construction yielding nontrivial observables with demonstrable consistency and the expected protected/compactification checks.
status_note: String/M-theory embeddings, protected sectors and compactification descriptions supply powerful information but are not the requested complete intrinsic construction.
